title: 秋華賞の後に・変わったのは

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I did well in the Shuka Sho (as you probably saw on TV)… But it wasn't a dazzling performance.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But my fans kept saying it was! I know that should've made me happy, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Was I really that dazzling? I don't even know anymore… What am I supposed to be running for now?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: …Sorry. I don't want to make you worry. You know, I don't think I'm gonna be sending this letter…
